pages.title: Nature's Ritual
pages.text: Nature's Ritual is a structured transmutation process performed at a Ritual Table. It draws upon surrounding braziers, salt, and nearby plant life to reshape materials into new forms.

pages.title: Structure
pages.text: A Ritual Table must be surrounded by four $(l:hexalia:blocks/ritual_brazier)Ritual Braziers$(/l), placed in the cardinal directions. Each brazier contributes to the ritual and must be properly prepared.

pages.title: Preparation
pages.text: Ingredients are placed within the braziers and covered with $(l:hexalia:resources/salt)Salt$(/l). A base item is then set on the table, ready to receive the transformation.

pages.title: Activation
pages.text: When activated with a Hex Focus, the ritual draws energy from the prepared braziers and nearby cultivated land, channeling it into the item at the center.

pages.title: On Growth
pages.text: Nature's Ritual depends on surrounding life. Nearby fully grown crops are consumed in the process, returning to early growth as their energy is drawn into the ritual.

pages.title: Result
pages.text: If the ritual is correctly prepared, the base item is transformed. The ingredients and salt are consumed, and the braziers return to an idle state.

pages.title: On Failure
pages.text: Improper preparation—such as missing salt, incorrect ingredients, or insufficient surrounding growth—will prevent the ritual from completing.
